messages:
Lena Ortiz: Heads-up 1: Customer 'Elmbridge' ran onboarding smoke and reported p95 ~720ms vs their SLO 250ms. Can we validate? :nerd_face:

Samir Nadeem: Looking now. Quick check shows eu-central spikes at 2025-11-02T11:05-11:10 UTC. p50 fine, p95 elevated.

infra-bot: Alert: region=eu-central latency_p95>/v1/complete > 500ms for 6m. Ticket INF-9002 created.

Priya Rao: If this is an infra-side miss we need the minute-level evidence and credit calc. Elmbridge is on a reserved monthly commit of $18k, so legal review will be needed if calc > threshold.

Samir Nadeem: I exported the minute CSV to INF-9002. Looks like 5 consecutive minutes > 500ms, weighted p95 ~710ms. There was an autoscaler ramp at 11:06 with a 75s ramp time.

Lena Ortiz: Probable root cause?

Samir Nadeem: Operator-initiated drain overlapped with rolling updates on that dedicated pool. No model fallback triggered.

Priya Rao: OK. Draft customer note (short):
"Hi Elmbridge team 1: We saw a brief performance degradation in eu-central during your smoke test (2025-11-02 11:0511:10 UTC). Our engineers traced this to an overlapping maintenance drain which caused elevated p95s. We've opened INF-9002 and attached minute-level metrics. We're calculating the SLO credit and will confirm by EOD."

Lena Ortiz: Action items: Samir attach host IDs + CSV to INF-9002; Priya draft credit amount using standard template; I'll loop in renewals if it affects the renewal risk score.

Samir Nadeem: Done - CSV and traces are in the ticket.

infra-bot: Note: autoscaler safety pad applied to pool eu-central-2. Monitoring for 24h.

Priya Rao: I'll run the credit calc and post to INF-9002 by lunch.
